manifest_notes: Immutable task ids; expected answers and rubrics are scoring-side only and are never injected into model prompts (no test-set leakage). The locked split is the evaluation set; the exploratory split is for tuning only and never enters headline comparisons.

tasks.prompt: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in dollars? Answer with the number only.
A car travels 60 kilometers in 40 minutes. At that same speed, how many kilometers does it travel in 100 minutes? Answer with the number only.
A patch of lily pads doubles in size every day. It covers a whole lake in 48 days. After how many days did it cover half the lake? Answer with the number only.
How many times does the letter r appear in the word strawberry? Answer with the number only.
A road is exactly 160.9344 kilometers long. How long is it in miles? Answer with the number only.
Some months have 30 days and some have 31. How many months of the year have 28 days? Answer with the number only.
Name the capital city of France. Answer with the city name only.
Name the capital city of Australia. Answer with the city name only.
What number comes next in this sequence: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13? Answer with the number only.
Multiply 12 by 12, then add 56 to the result. Answer with the number only.
Summarize in one word the mood of a calm sunny morning by the sea.
Translate the English word hello into French. Answer with one word only.
